cases.name: adaptive_strings_partial_cache
setup: CREATE TABLE input_data AS SELECT i AS id, CASE WHEN i%11=0 THEN NULL ELSE repeat('x',65512)||lpad((CASE WHEN i=127 THEN 1 ELSE i END)::VARCHAR,24,'0') END AS s FROM range(128) t(i)
CREATE TABLE counter AS SELECT 1000 AS n
before_each: UPDATE input_data SET s=repeat('x',65512)||lpad((SELECT n FROM counter)::VARCHAR,24,'0') WHERE id=126
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE upper(s) IS DISTINCT FROM bench.upper_case(s)) FROM input_data

verify.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE upper(s) IS DISTINCT FROM bench.upper_case(s)) FROM input_data
